paras: Cyrtopodion potoharense, commonly known as the Potahar gecko or the Potwar gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to northern Pakistan.
C. potoharense is found in Rawalpindi District, Punjab Province, Pakistan.
The natural habitat of C. potoharense is mud flats.
